mapper.insert: insert into inventory_items (house_id, name, unit, current_qty, low_stock_qty, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{name}, #{unit}, #{currentQty}, #{lowStockQty}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select: select id, house_id, name, unit, current_qty, low_stock_qty, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from inventory_items where house_id = #{houseId} and name = #{name} limit 1
select id, house_id, name, unit, current_qty, low_stock_qty, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from inventory_items where house_id = #{houseId} order by id desc
